hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || { echo "Refused: the MCP guard could not find the repository root." >&2; exit 2; }; bun "$root/.claude/hooks/refuse-production-mcp.ts"; code=$?; [ "$code" -eq 0 ] || [ "$code" -eq 2 ] || echo "Refused: the MCP guard failed with exit $code, so it cannot rule out PROD." >&2; [ "$code" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that the MCP tool does not reach production
